our_interpretation: The deadline and revenue scope come from the immediately preceding sentence quoted in the supplied context.
Read $2T as USD 2 trillion in aggregate annual AI revenue achieved by the end of 2030, rather than cumulative revenue or an annualized run rate.
Read new ideas as substantive technical changes beyond adding data and compute to otherwise unchanged LLM methods.
The antecedent includes enduring limits on pure LLM scaling. Present failures or the absence of AGI today do not establish that antecedent.
This is a necessity claim. Reaching the revenue target using new ideas would not alone prove that those ideas were necessary.

criteria.contradiction_condition: The stated LLM limits are established, but the specified annual revenue threshold is reached by the deadline using existing LLM methods and pure scaling without the asserted necessary innovations.
